newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide sees Q1 EPS $1.03 vs $1.01.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide sees Q1 EPS $1.03 vs $1.01.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp said Thursday its preliminary first quarter earnings per share rose to $1.03 from $1.01 a year earlier.
Net income was flat at $155 million, it said.
The consensus earnings estimate for the company is $0.86 a share among 16 analysts that follow Union Carbide, according to First Call.
Union Carbide's stock was up 1-3/8 to 44-1/2.
Union Carbide said its basic chemicals and polymers unit reported operating profits of $62 million for the first quarter, up from $58 million a year ago.
Basic chemicals and polymers benefited from improved volumes and pricing, as well as lower feedstock costs, it said.
Specialty chemicals and intermediates posted a slightly lower operating profit at $184 million in the first quarter, down from $193 million a year ago.
Weak pricing for solvents, intermediates and nomomeers combined with high energy costs and propylene costs hurt specialty chemical and intermediates results, Union Carbide said.
Full results will be reported on April 21, the company said.
